author: dev_revs
body:
Hey guys! Super sorry its so late, I've been really busy lately and haven't had time to check the maps and get this post out. Anyways, here is the FINAL map pool for the event! Containing three CTF Holiday maps, and two KOTH maps.

Veto Process:

Bo1
Higher seed vetos
Lower seed vetos
Higher seed vetos
Lower seed vetos
Remaining map is played.
Bo3
Higher seed picks a map
Lower Seed picks a map
Higher seed vetos
Lower seed vetos
Remaining map is the third

Maps:

Flush CTF; By Strangey & NixaniaXi [/sn Flush Holiday]


Draxel KoTH; Fouled & Claf  [/sn Draxel Holiday]


Alpine CTF; By dev_revs, Leyre, Flaan [/sn Alpine Holiday]


Yukon 2 CTF; By Spooks and lgmatias [/sn Yukon 2 Holiday]


Stalactite KoTH; By Stuarts and Myv [/sn Stalactite]
